# fct_booking_supplier_invoices

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_booking_supplier_invoices` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Invoices and Commission Estimates. Includes information about invoice amounts, balances, and reconciliation. Each row represents a single invoice/estimate (which equates to one row per Booking). Sourced from Invoiced Syncs stored in the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `billed_currency` | The currency that the invoice total and balance are provided in. >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `booking_uuid` | The UUID (not the ID, though sometimes they are mislabeled in portal tables) of the associated Booking >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `cadence_id` | Unique identifier of the cadence in Invoiced >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `cadence_name` | Name of the chasing cadence in Invoiced, which allows for automated chasing of invoices >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `commission_total_amount_usd` | The gross commission value (what Fora is supposed to be paid) in $ >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `confirmation_number` | The confirmation number for the invoice >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `estimate_created_at` | When the estimate was first created >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_balance_amount_billed_currency` | Invoice balance = the invoice total less any payments >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_canceled_at` | When the invoice was canceled >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_created_at` | When the invoice was first created >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_number` | Reference number of the invoice. >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_paid_at` | When the invoice was paid by the Supplier >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_sent_at` | When the invoice was first sent >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_sent_first_attempted_at` | When the first send attempt was made >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_status` | The status of the invoice, such as 'past_due' >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_total_amount_billed_currency` | The total amount of the invoice, in the billed currency (not necessarily USD) >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoice_updated_at` | When the invoice was last updated in the Invoiced platform (may be different from when the record was updated in Portal) >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoiced_customer_id` | The customer ID, as identified in the Invoiced platform>> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoiced_estimate_id` | The estimate ID, as identified in the Invoiced platform >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoiced_first_payment_id` | The first payment ID, as identified in the Invoiced platform >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoiced_invoice_id` | The invoice ID in the Invoiced platform >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `invoiced_sync_id` | Primary key, the ID from the invoiced_syncs table in Portal. >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null - row_count: arguments: |
| `is_cadence_chased` | Whether the invoice's cadence was ever turned on if the invoice was assigned to a cadence. False if the invoice has been assigned a cadence but was never turned on. Null if there was never a cadence assignment. >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `payment_first_reconciled_at` | When a payment was first reconciled for the invoice >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `payment_terms` | Payment terms for the supplier to pay us, such as NET 30, END_OF_THE_MONTH, or UPON_RECEIPT >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
| `url` | The url on invoiced.com for the given invoice >> SOURCE - Invoiced Syncs in Portal |
